description.p: Emoxidize is a fast, single-instance emoji picker built with GTK4 and libadwaita. It presents a searchable grid of all canonical Unicode emojis, grouped into Recents, Smileys, People, Animals, Food, Travel, Activities, Objects, Symbols and Flags, with live search over CLDR names and keywords, skin-tone support and configurable grid columns.
Selecting an emoji copies it to the clipboard and dismisses the picker (or keeps it open for consecutive selections in multi-emoji mode).
